_about: WO50 §3: each site's validation rules in one place — the title checker (thrift_agent/titles.py), the copy and the posters read them. A rule learned from a site's own refusal says where it came from.

title.caps_share_why: Vinted refused 'BCBGMAXAZRIA New Black Slouchy Shoulder Bag Knotted Strap' (38% capitals: 'Title contains too many capital letters, try using lowercase letters', POST /api/v2/item_upload/items 400, 2026-10-24) and accepted every one of our 70 titles up to 29% ('FRAME Le High Straight Jeans Medium Blue Wash Raw Hem size 00'): its limit lies above 29% and at or below 38%. The fixer aims for 29% or less (caps_share_safe: lower-case connecting words); the checker blocks only above 35% (caps_share_max), so a title with real acronyms (NYDJ, DKNY) is never held; after Vinted's own refusal the retry goes further (sentence case beyond the brand and acronyms).

refusals.seen: 2026-10-24, the BCBG bag: 'Title contains too many capital letters, try using lowercase letters.'

refusals.match: title (?:is )?too long|title (?:must|can) (?:be|contain) at most|title is longer
